claims.text: Some pts: a trial of the S1P-r modulator ozanimod or etrasimod can be considered.
claims.quote: Finally, in some patients, a trial of the small-molecule Janus kinase inhibitors (tofacitinib or upadacitinib) or the sphingosine 1-phosphate receptor modulator ozanimod or etrasimod can be considered.

claims.text: Zeposia (ozanimod): mod-severe active UC in adults.
claims.quote: Moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis (UC) in adults.

claims.text: Velsipity (etrasimod): mod-severe active UC in adults.
claims.quote: VELSIPITY is indicated for the treatment of moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis (UC) in adults.
